CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_REPAYMENTPLANPAYMENT_LNS
AS
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment
AS(
SELECT
BLG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
,BLL.SHDL_NUM AS ScheduleNumber
,BLL.DMD_FLOW_ID AS DemandFLowId
,BLL.DMD_DATE AS DemandDate
,BLL.DMD_SRL_NUM AS DemandSerialNumber
,BLL.DEL_FLG AS DeletedIndicator
,BLL.LD_FREQ_TYPE AS LoanDemandFrequencyTypeId
,BLL.DMD_EFF_DATE AS DemandEffectiveDate
,BLL.DMD_OVDU_DATE as DemandOverdueDate
,BLL.DMD_AMT AS DemandAmount
,BLL.EI_AMT AS EquatedInstallmentAmount
,BLL.LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG AS LateFeeStatusIndicator
,BLL.DEMAND_IND AS DemandIndicator
,BLL.LDT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
,BLL.CRYSTALLISED_AMT AS CrystallisedAmount
,BLL.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
,NULL AS TotalRefundAmount
,BLL.TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT AS TotalInstallmentAdjustedtAmount
,NULL AS AccruedDemandAmount
,BLL.FEE_TYPE AS FeeType
,BLL.ASSOCIATION_ID AS AssociationId
,'LNS' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,BLLD.RECORD_STATUS AS RECORD_STATUS
,BLL.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
,0 as WorkFlowId
,0 as TaskRunId

FROM BUSC.LNS_LADMD_DELTA BLLD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_LADMD BLL ON BLL.ACID = BLLD.ACID AND BLL.ISLATEST = '1'
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG ON BLG.ACID = BLLD.ACID

UNION

SELECT
BLG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
,BLL.SHDL_NUM AS ScheduleNumber
,BLL.DMD_FLOW_ID AS DemandFLowId
,BLL.DMD_DATE AS DemandDate
,BLL.DMD_SRL_NUM AS DemandSerialNumber
,BLL.DEL_FLG AS DeletedIndicator
,BLL.LD_FREQ_TYPE AS LoanDemandFrequencyTypeId
,BLL.DMD_EFF_DATE AS DemandEffectiveDate
,BLL.DMD_OVDU_DATE AS DemandOverdueDate
,BLL.DMD_AMT AS DemandAmount
,NULL AS EquatedInstallmentAmount
,NULL AS LateFeeStatusIndicator
,NULL AS DemandIndicator
,BLL.LDT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
,NULL AS CrystallisedAmount
,BLL.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
,BLL.TOT_REFUND_AMT AS TotalRefundAmount
,NULL AS TotalInstallmentAdjustedtAmount
,BLL.ACCRUED_DMD_AMT AS AccruedDemandAmount
,BLL.FEE_TYPE AS FeeType
,NULL AS AssociationId
,'LNS' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,BLLD.RECORD_STATUS AS RECORD_STATUS
,BLL.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
,0 as WorkFlowId
,0 as TaskRunId

FROM BUSC.LNS_LAPENALDMD_DELTA BLLD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_LAPENALDMD BLL ON BLL.ACID = BLLD.ACID AND BLL.ISLATEST = '1'
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG ON BLG.ACID = BLLD.ACID
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment FROM TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,ScheduleNumber
,DemandFLowId
,DemandDate
,DemandSerialNumber
,DeletedIndicator
,LoanDemandFrequencyTypeId
,DemandEffectiveDate
,DemandOverdueDate
,DemandAmount
,EquatedInstallmentAmount
,LateFeeStatusIndicator
,DemandIndicator
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CrystallisedAmount
,FinancialInstitutionId
,TotalRefundAmount
,TotalInstallmentAdjustedtAmount
,AccruedDemandAmount
,FeeType
,AssociationId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,ScheduleNumber
,DemandFLowId
,DemandDate
,DemandSerialNumber
,DeletedIndicator
,LoanDemandFrequencyTypeId
,DemandEffectiveDate
,DemandOverdueDate
,DemandAmount
,EquatedInstallmentAmount
,LateFeeStatusIndicator
,DemandIndicator
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CrystallisedAmount
,FinancialInstitutionId
,TotalRefundAmount
,TotalInstallmentAdjustedtAmount
,AccruedDemandAmount
,FeeType
,AssociationId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.RepaymentPlanPayment 
),

TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT
SET

CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId 
,ScheduleNumber = SRC.ScheduleNumber 
,DemandFLowId = SRC.DemandFLowId 
,DemandDate = SRC.DemandDate 
,DemandSerialNumber = SRC.DemandSerialNumber 
,DeletedIndicator = SRC.DeletedIndicator 
,LoanDemandFrequencyTypeId = SRC.LoanDemandFrequencyTypeId 
,DemandEffectiveDate = SRC.DemandEffectiveDate 
,DemandOverdueDate = SRC.DemandOverdueDate 
,DemandAmount = SRC.DemandAmount 
,EquatedInstallmentAmount = SRC.EquatedInstallmentAmount 
,LateFeeStatusIndicator = SRC.LateFeeStatusIndicator
,DemandIndicator = SRC.DemandIndicator
,IsoCurrencyCode = SRC.IsoCurrencyCode
,CrystallisedAmount = SRC.CrystallisedAmount
,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,TotalRefundAmount = SRC.TotalRefundAmount
,TotalInstallmentAdjustedtAmount = SRC.TotalInstallmentAdjustedtAmount
,AccruedDemandAmount = SRC.AccruedDemandAmount
,FeeType = SRC.FeeType
,AssociationId = SRC.AssociationId
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS'
,WorkFlowId = 0
,TaskRunId = 0
,INSERTDTTM = SRC.INSERTDTTM
FROM BNKM.RepaymentPlanPayment TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId;



--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.RepaymentPlanPayment
(
CustomerAccountId
,ScheduleNumber
,DemandFLowId
,DemandDate
,DemandSerialNumber
,DeletedIndicator
,LoanDemandFrequencyTypeId
,DemandEffectiveDate
,DemandOverdueDate
,DemandAmount
,EquatedInstallmentAmount
,LateFeeStatusIndicator
,DemandIndicator
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CrystallisedAmount
,FinancialInstitutionId
,TotalRefundAmount
,TotalInstallmentAdjustedtAmount
,AccruedDemandAmount
,FeeType
,AssociationId
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
CustomerAccountId
,ScheduleNumber
,DemandFLowId
,DemandDate
,DemandSerialNumber
,DeletedIndicator
,LoanDemandFrequencyTypeId
,DemandEffectiveDate
,DemandOverdueDate
,DemandAmount
,EquatedInstallmentAmount
,LateFeeStatusIndicator
,DemandIndicator
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CrystallisedAmount
,FinancialInstitutionId
,TotalRefundAmount
,TotalInstallmentAdjustedtAmount
,AccruedDemandAmount
,FeeType
,AssociationId
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,InsertDttm

FROM #TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_RepaymentPlanPayment_DELTA;

END
